item.title: Ground Broken On City’s Lots-To-Housing Plan
item.description: The Elicker administration took another step towards bringing 19 new units of housing to a handful of vacant lots on Starr Street Tuesday morning with a groundbreaking ceremony celebrating a $7.6 million affordable-homeownership-development project. item.title: What A Difference A Day Makes
item.description: The corner of Wolcott and Lloyd streets is clear, for now, a day after the Fair Haven intersection's sidewalk was piled high with a couch, mattresses, board games, and trash bags. The Elicker administration has also sent a bill worth more than $1,800 to the person allegedly responsible for this illegal dumping. The post What A Difference A Day Makes appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Hill Voters Hit The Polls In Another Contentious Pittman-Hubbard Race
item.description: Lee Moore stopped by Career High School Tuesday, still weighing who to vote for in a contested Democratic co-chair race. In the end, she decided on Sandra Pittman. Pittman is running with Lisa Velazquez Torres to become the next Ward 3 co-chairs. The two are up against incumbents Clarence Cummings and Alder Angel Hubbard. The post Hill Voters Hit The Polls In Another Contentious Pittman-Hubbard Race appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Pittman Beats Hubbard In Hill Co-Chair Race
item.description: Sandra Pittman and Lisa Velazquez Torres unseated Angel Hubbard and Clarence Cummings as Ward 3 Democratic co-chairs Tuesday after racking up enough absentee-ballot votes to overcome a split-ticket result at the polls. The post Pittman Beats Hubbard In Hill Co-Chair Race appeared first on New Haven Independent.
